description: P096 Step 11: which finding of the whole-plan round (cp7) matched each recorded auditor finding. Judged by the controller on 2026-09-20 from the live answers in answers/. `matched_by` is the fingerprint of the accepted finding in that round; `mechanism` names the deterministic check that makes the finding impossible to reach, where no reviewer is meant to find it.

entries.mechanism: freeze re-runs every gate and review whose inputs moved, so no result of an older commit reaches decide (test-plan-final-decide.bats: 'a code fix re-reads everything')
